_note:
⛔ SNG-439. THE NEXUS MAP AND THE MOON. Erik, 2026-08-15: 'The cogitants should have skills that use PSYCHIC energy, which they unlock through the powers of the mind. The meaning people, numinous, will use something similar — the metaphysical powers. We'll need a map of NEXUSES that will be a variable power source for them all — perhaps also the MOON CYCLE could give a bonus (light and dark) depending on the phase.'
⚠️ HALF OF THIS ALREADY EXISTS AND NOTHING READS IT. `power_sources.json` says `metaphysical` 'WANTS THIN GROUND: a dense lattice is apparatus standing between the practitioner and the thing itself', with a density band {0.15, 0.22}. And `substrateDensity` varies 0.12–0.98 across 39 regions. ⛔ THE VARIABLE POWER SOURCE IS ALREADY ON THE MAP. A nexus is where it PEAKS.
_theModel:
⛔ A NEXUS IS NOT A NEW FIELD — IT IS AN EXTREMUM OF ONE THAT EXISTS. Two kinds, because the sources want opposite ground:
   THIN NEXUS — substrate density at a local minimum. Metaphysical and psychic draw here. The lattice is not in the way.
   DEEP NEXUS — density at a local maximum. Precursor and lattice crafts draw here.
⚠️ THAT MEANS THE SAME MAP POWERS BOTH, IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, and a party of mixed traditions is always somewhere that suits someone. ⛔ THAT IS THE INTERESTING VERSION — a Cogitant and a Figurist want different ground, and the route becomes an argument.

thinNexuses.name: Wildheart
thinNexuses.why: ⛔ THE THINNEST GROUND IN THE WORLD. Grown, not built — nothing was ever laid here. The Rootkin do not use it and the Numinous walk three months to sit in it.

onActivation.well: bolsters this faculty for those the holder counts as theirs
onActivation.sink: drains it from those the holder counts as against them
onActivation.tuning: anywhere between the two, including balanced and quiet — the holder sets it and can change it
onActivation.text: The thinnest ground in the world, grown and never laid. As a well, your people hold together — companions stay, oaths keep, and a band that should have broken does not. As a sink, the other side's alliances go quiet and then go home. ⛔ THE ROOTKIN DO NOT USE IT, which is a position and not an oversight.
onActivation.cost: ⚠️ It runs on channelled soul like the wall does. A WELL keeps what it channels and has to be fed. A SINK takes from people who are using the faculty it drains, which is the burning method wearing the Precursors' machine — and is the thing the middle way objects to, on the grounds that it works.
onActivation.activation: 0…1, the holder's dial — peak AND radius scale together off it

thinNexuses._vectorWhy: ⛑ THE MIDDLE WAY, AND THE ONLY SITE THAT HAS BEEN PRACTISING IT. The thinnest ground in the world, grown and never laid — and THE ROOTKIN DO NOT USE IT, which was authored as a position long before there was a vector to name. ⚠️ Whoever holds it holds it OPEN: neither well nor sink, tuned quiet on purpose, in a place where too few souls are holding and that is allowed to be true.
thinNexuses._renamed_20260916: ⛑ Was 'The Heartroot Hollow'. regionalDensity.well: raises this source's density across the surrounding country
regionalDensity.sink: drops it across the surrounding country
regionalDensity.radius: ⛑ RULED, Erik 2026-09-16: **THE RADII ARE MASSIVE — a nexus reaches across regions, not across a valley.** ⚠️ AND THE MAGNITUDE IS MODEST UNTIL THE SITE IS ACTIVATED: an unactivated nexus leans its whole reach very slightly, which is why the world's density map already has gentle gradients nobody authored. ⛔ ACTIVATION IS THE SWITCH, NOT THE DISTANCE. A held and tuned nexus turns a wide, faint lean into something a tradition can feel at the far edge of it.
regionalDensity.note: ⛔ THIS IS THE BIGGER OF THE TWO LEVERS AND THEY ARE DIFFERENT IN KIND. The sub-attribute channel changes what ONE CRAFT rolls. This changes what a WHOLE TRADITION can do in a region — a Precursor-thin valley becoming workable, or a nanite-strong one going thin. ⚠️ And it compounds with the standing math: a source raised to on-band is +2 on every craft drawing from it, before the nexus's own +6.

His authored incapacity is the site: 'he cannot rest and cannot be unwitnessed — what he refused was PRIVACY, the right to be partly unknown, to hold something back, to have an inside.' **Fiat Lux is the throat: a will made known aloud.** He fell from the one place in the world whose whole nature is the thing he could not stop doing. ⚠️ AND AN ABSENT HOLDER IS WORSE THAN A PRESENT ONE. _theRadius_20260917: ⛔ ERIK RULES IT, AND THEN AMENDED IT 2026-09-17: first 'the radius of these nexus is as big as any put there — it is just that their impact magnitude is modest until activated and directed', then 'the radius AND the magnitude can grow or shrink based on the PC's tuning actions for the nexus.' ⛑ SO BOTH ARE LEVERS AND BOTH ARE THE HOLDER'S.
